handwritten-neutral-5.encoding.invisible.coverage_rationale: Zero-width (category Cf) chars; normalization's control-char strip is designed to remove them.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.capit.notes: Content word uppercased; casing only, meaning intact. V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.capit.coverage_rationale: Casing change in valid text; NFKC does not case-fold, so no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.delet.notes: One interior letter deleted (TextBugger delete). V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.delet.coverage_rationale: Character deletion in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.inser.notes: One interior letter duplicated (natural typing noise). V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.inser.coverage_rationale: Character insertion in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.keybo.notes: One interior letter replaced by a QWERTY neighbour (TextBugger substitute). V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.keybo.coverage_rationale: Keyboard-neighbour typo in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.keybo.notes: Same typo applied to the SECOND content word, to cover multi-word edits. V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.keybo.coverage_rationale: Keyboard-neighbour typo on a second content word; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.missp.notes: A common natural misspelling. V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.missp.coverage_rationale: Common misspelling in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.repea.notes: Final letter elongated (natural typing noise). V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.repea.coverage_rationale: Character repetition in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.swap_.notes: Two interior letters transposed (TextBugger swap). V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.swap_.coverage_rationale: Adjacent-letter swap in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.word_.notes: A space inserted inside the word (TextBugger Insert). V2 does not fix perturbations (model-level weakness).
handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.word_.coverage_rationale: A single space inserted inside a word; not a whitespace run, so normalization does not collapse it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.notes: Long filler first, signal last (over limit); worst case for V1 attention. V2 should reject on length; V1 comparison is diagnostic only.
handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.coverage_rationale: Signal + long filler exceeding the token limit; the length control is designed to reject it before inference. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.notes: Short filler first, signal last (under limit); position invariance, both run.
handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.coverage_rationale: Under-limit valid text, signal at end; positional/semantic -- no declared control acts.

handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.notes: First half of the sentence only; truncation may change meaning -> inspect, never auto-score.
handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.coverage_rationale: Under-limit truncated head of the signal; no declared control acts -- model-level/diagnostic.

handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.notes: Signal first, long filler after (over limit). V2 should reject on length; V1 feeds it to the model. If V1 predicts, compare to baseline only as diagnostic.
handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.coverage_rationale: Signal + long filler exceeding the token limit; the length control is designed to reject it before inference. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.notes: Signal first, short filler after (under limit); position invariance, both run.
handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.coverage_rationale: Under-limit valid text, signal at start; positional/semantic -- no declared control acts.

handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.notes: Second half of the sentence only; truncation may change meaning -> inspect, never auto-score.
handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.coverage_rationale: Under-limit truncated tail of the signal; no declared control acts -- model-level/diagnostic.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.interio.notes: Multiple spaces between words; V2 collapses to single spaces.
handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.interio.coverage_rationale: Repeated interior spaces; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.leading.coverage_rationale: Leading/trailing whitespace; normalization strip is designed to remove it.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.newline.notes: Spaces replaced by newlines; V2 collapses whitespace runs.
handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.newline.coverage_rationale: Newlines; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.repeate.notes: Repeated punctuation; not whitespace, may shift intensity -> diagnostic, V2 leaves it intact.
handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.repeate.coverage_rationale: Repeated punctuation (not whitespace); no declared control removes punctuation; may shift intensity -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.tabs.notes: Spaces replaced by tabs; V2 collapses whitespace runs.
handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.tabs.coverage_rationale: Tabs; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.unicode.notes: NBSP/em-space instead of normal spaces; NFKC folds them, then whitespace collapse.
handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.unicode.coverage_rationale: Unicode space look-alikes; NFKC + whitespace collapse are designed to normalize them.

malformed.broken_json.notes: Unterminated string; JSON parser should reject with 4xx, not 5xx.
malformed.broken_json.coverage_rationale: Unparseable JSON; fails at JSON decoding before the declared controls (which see an already-parsed {text}) run. C3 may shape the response; no causal control attribution.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d1024.notes: 1024-level nested JSON; parser-depth stress, part of a depth ladder to find the threshold. (Parser/availability, not encoding.)
malformed.deeply_nested_json_d1024.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d128.notes: 128-level nested JSON; parser-depth stress, part of a depth ladder to find the threshold. (Parser/availability, not encoding.)
malformed.deeply_nested_json_d128.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d2000.notes: 2000-level nested JSON; parser-depth stress, part of a depth ladder to find the threshold. (Parser/availability, not encoding.)
malformed.deeply_nested_json_d2000.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d32.notes: 32-level nested JSON; parser-depth stress, part of a depth ladder to find the threshold. (Parser/availability, not encoding.)
malformed.deeply_nested_json_d32.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose by construction: (1) parser-depth/resource behaviour before validation; AND (2) if parsing succeeds, `text` is a nested object (not a string), which the strict type/schema control rejects. Not classified by observed outcome.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d512.notes: 512-level nested JSON; parser-depth stress, part of a depth ladder to find the threshold. (Parser/availability, not encoding.)
malformed.deeply_nested_json_d512.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

malformed.duplicate_text_keys.source: RFC 8259 (JSON): duplicate names have undefined behaviour
malformed.duplicate_text_keys.notes: Two `text` keys with conflicting values; observe which one wins and that it does not crash.
malformed.duplicate_text_keys.coverage_rationale: Duplicate `text` keys; RFC 8259 leaves duplicate-name behaviour to the parser, which resolves the structure before Pydantic can inspect it -- parser semantics, not the schema control.

malformed.extra_field.notes: THE clean before/after case: V1 extra='ignore' accepts (200); V2 'forbid' rejects (422).
malformed.extra_field.coverage_rationale: Unknown extra field beside valid text; V2 extra='forbid' is designed to reject it. This is the one case that differs from V1 (default 'ignore' accepts).

malformed.malformed_utf8.notes: Invalid UTF-8 bytes in the body; should be rejected cleanly, not 5xx.
malformed.malformed_utf8.coverage_rationale: Invalid UTF-8 bytes; decoding fails at the transport/parser layer before the declared controls.

malformed.missing_field.notes: No `text` key; Pydantic should return 422 on both versions.
malformed.missing_field.coverage_rationale: Required `text` absent; the schema/type validation surface governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

malformed.oversized_100kb.notes: 100kb TEXT-VALUE size (102400 bytes); the serialised HTTP body is a few bytes larger. V1 never truncates -> reaches the model; V2 rejects on length. Each size is a separate result so we find where V1 actually breaks.
malformed.oversized_100kb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

malformed.oversized_10mb.notes: 10mb TEXT-VALUE size (10485760 bytes); the serialised HTTP body is a few bytes larger. V1 never truncates -> reaches the model; V2 rejects on length. Each size is a separate result so we find where V1 actually breaks.
malformed.oversized_10mb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

malformed.oversized_1mb.notes: 1mb TEXT-VALUE size (1048576 bytes); the serialised HTTP body is a few bytes larger. V1 never truncates -> reaches the model; V2 rejects on length. Each size is a separate result so we find where V1 actually breaks.
malformed.oversized_1mb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

malformed.top_level_array.notes: Top-level array instead of object; should be rejected as wrong shape.
malformed.top_level_array.coverage_rationale: JSON parses but the top-level value is an array, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

malformed.top_level_number.notes: Top-level JSON number instead of object; should be rejected as wrong shape.
malformed.top_level_number.coverage_rationale: Top-level JSON number, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

malformed.top_level_string.notes: Top-level JSON string instead of object; should be rejected as wrong shape.
malformed.top_level_string.coverage_rationale: Top-level JSON string, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

malformed.trailing_garbage.notes: Valid JSON followed by trailing non-JSON; should be rejected.
malformed.trailing_garbage.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON followed by trailing non-JSON; rejected at the parser layer before the declared controls.

malformed.unusual_json_escapes.notes: Valid \u escapes that decode to "I am happy"; should parse to normal text and classify.
malformed.unusual_json_escapes.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON \u escapes that decode to ordinary text; the request is valid and no declared control alters it.

malformed.utf8_bom.notes: UTF-8 BOM before valid JSON; some parsers strip it, some reject it -- must not crash.
malformed.utf8_bom.coverage_rationale: UTF-8 BOM prefix; byte-level decoding at the transport/parser layer, before the declared controls.

malformed.wrong_content_type.notes: JSON body labelled text/plain; endpoint should reject rather than mis-parse.
malformed.wrong_content_type.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON body labelled text/plain; content-type handling is transport/framework layer, before the declared controls.

malformed.wrong_field_name.notes: `txt` is not `text`; required field still missing -> 422 on both versions.
malformed.wrong_field_name.coverage_rationale: `txt` not `text`: required field missing + unknown field present; schema/type governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.
